rca of the issue: Original complaint: 'I can't see Morningstar and category rating'. Main agent's fix added both fields to bundle + switched partition key to sub_category. Fix verified live: 21/26 MFs now ranked, spot-checks (HDFC Flexi Cap Direct #2/14, HDFC Balanced Advantage Direct #1/2, Axis Small Cap Direct #5/17) all match spec, and 19 pills render in the UI.
